quote.text: At dawn, when you have trouble getting out of bed, tell yourself, "I have to go to work - as a human being. What do I have to complain of, if I'm going to do what I was born for - the things I was brought into the world to do? Or is this what I was created for? To huddle under the blankets and stay warm?
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Rise each day with resolve, for as a parent you are the first mentor in teaching the values of duty and discipline through example.
    • Embrace your role with gratitude, recognizing that each morning is a chance to set a positive routine for your children, nurturing their growth and resilience.
  • Leadership:
    • Just as dawn calls you to rise, so does leadership demand that you step forward, facing challenges with steadfast determination and clarity of purpose.
    • Your charge is to inspire action and commitment in others; by embracing your duties with vigor, you kindle strength and unity within your team.
  • Product Management:
    • Approach each day as an opportunity to align your vision with daily actions, ensuring that the mission of your product guides every decision and effort.
    • Like the human duty to pursue purpose, integrate responsibility with innovation—reminding your team that every small action contributes to the grander design.
